findings.summary: kernel-schema-validator.validate nests 4–6 levels in additionalProperties and if/then/else paths, making the schema interpreter hard to change safely.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Extract helper functions so validate keyword branches stay at nesting depth ≤3 without changing validation semantics.

findings.summary: Then-branch annotation loop in kernel-schema-validator is a no-op identity on rule despite a comment claiming annotation.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Either implement real then-branch rule annotation or remove/replace the misleading comment so intent matches code.

findings.summary: transition-parity.normalize surface discrimination is opaque: the 'already a surface' branch often falls through without a documented shape matrix.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Document or explicitly branch each input shape (human projection vs envelope vs raw next_transition) so normalization paths are unambiguous.

findings.summary: k1-maturity extractMaturityEntries uses opaque lineNo +1/−1 arithmetic without explaining 1-based offender paths.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Clarify line indexing with a short comment or simplify to a single obvious 1-based counter.

findings.summary: TAG_RE is exported from k1-maturity but check() uses a duplicated inline regex.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Use TAG_RE (or a shared constant) on the hot path so maturity tags have one source of truth.
